description: Import a video for AI shorts generation. Sources: library (video_id), youtube (source_url). Default config: vertical aspect, 30-60s duration, no captions. Video must be CONVERTED, 5min-5hrs, <50GB, no DRM.

end_time.description: End time in seconds to clip to (default: full video)

source_type.description: Source: 'library' for Panda video, 'youtube' for YouTube URL

start_time.description: Start time in seconds to clip from (default: 0)

video_id.description: Video ID from Panda library (required when source_type=library)

video_title.description: Title for the project (defaults to 'Shorts Project')

name: panda_import_video_for_shorts
title: Import Video for Shorts
